description: PRD-204 Input Validation Sweep — guard raw path-param ids into Prisma (parseUuid/parseSlug across ~41 dynamic routes), fix deepMerge prototype pollution, add a body-size-cap JSON helper, validate the customer/profile PATCH and super-admin tenant settings blob with Zod, and roll Zod onto remaining body routes.

userStories.title: parseUuid + parseSlug validation helpers
userStories.description: As a developer, I need shared helpers that reject malformed path params at the boundary so raw ids never reach Prisma.
acceptanceCriteria: Create lib/validation/parse-uuid.ts exporting parseUuid(value: string): string and parseSlug(value: string): string
parseUuid: trim, test against lenient UUID regex /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i; on mismatch throw new ApiError('Invalid request', 400)
parseSlug: trim, lowercase-validate against /^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,62}$/; on mismatch throw new ApiError('Invalid request', 400); return the trimmed value
Both reject empty/whitespace input with ApiError 400
tsc --noEmit passes
pnpm build passes

userStories.title: Fix deepMerge prototype pollution
userStories.description: As a developer, I need deepMerge to ignore __proto__/constructor/prototype keys so a JSON.parse'd payload cannot pollute Object.prototype.
acceptanceCriteria: Add const DANGEROUS_KEYS = new Set(['__proto__','constructor','prototype']) in lib/utils.ts
Skip dangerous keys (continue) as the first check inside the Object.keys loop, at every recursion level
Preserve existing semantics: override wins unless undefined/null/empty-string; arrays replace wholesale; plain objects deep-merge
tsc --noEmit passes
pnpm build passes

userStories.title: parseJsonBody body-size-cap helper
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a JSON body parser that enforces a size cap and optional Zod schema so large or malformed payloads are rejected uniformly.
acceptanceCriteria: Create lib/validation/body.ts exporting async parseJsonBody<T>(req: Request, schema?: ZodSchema<T>, opts?: { maxBytes?: number })
Default maxBytes 256*1024; read raw text, if byte length exceeds cap throw new ApiError('Request body too large', 413)
Invalid JSON throws new ApiError('Invalid request', 400)
If schema provided, run schema.parse and translate ZodError to new ApiError('Invalid request', 400)
tsc --noEmit passes
pnpm build passes

userStories.title: Strict tenant-settings schema + wire super-admin tenants/[id]
userStories.description: As a security engineer, I need the super-admin tenant settings blob validated against a strict allow-list schema (exported for PRD-208) and the route id parsed as a UUID.
acceptanceCriteria: Enumerate ALL legitimate tenant settings keys by grepping settings.* / settings?.[ access across app + lib (clerkOrgId, railwayDomainId, domain metadata, tenant-admin settings keys)
Create lib/validation/tenant-settings.ts exporting tenantSettingsSchema (z.object({...known optional}).strict()) and type TenantSettings
super-admin/tenants/[id] PATCH: parseUuid(params.id); validate caller-supplied settings with tenantSettingsSchema.partial() before the merge; unknown keys rejected with 400
No legitimate save key omitted from the schema (verify by enumeration, since no DB locally)
tsc --noEmit passes
pnpm build passes

userStories.title: Validate customer/profile PATCH with Zod + caps
userStories.description: As a security engineer, I need the customer profile update body validated and length-capped so unvalidated free-form data never reaches Prisma.
acceptanceCriteria: Zod schema: firstName/lastName optional string max 100; phone optional string max 32 matching a permissive phone pattern; address optional typed object (street/city/state/zip/country strings, each capped)
PATCH uses parseJsonBody(request, schema) and returns apiValidationError on invalid input (not a generic 500)
Only validated fields written to Prisma; existing name-backfill behaviour preserved
tsc --noEmit passes
pnpm build passes

userStories.title: parseSlug/parseUuid rollout: store/[slug]/* (9 files)
userStories.description: As a security engineer, I need every store storefront route to validate its slug (and orderId) before DB lookups.
acceptanceCriteria: All 9 store/[slug] route files call parseSlug(params.slug) before any DB use: cart/{add,clear,remove,route}, orders/{route,submit}, orders/[orderId]/route, products/{route,featured}
store/[slug]/orders/[orderId]/route also calls parseUuid(params.orderId)
Bare catch blocks in touched files swapped to return apiError(error, { route }) so the 400 propagates instead of becoming 500

pnpm build passes
